lines: [excited, punchy news-anchor energy] America just VOTED. [short pause] AI stocks just FELL. [pause] [curious, rising] Connected?
[neutral, clear, matter-of-fact] Tuesday, Democrats won the House and Senate, [short pause] AP says, [short pause] with a few races still counting.
[serious, with weight] Thursday, [short pause] the Nasdaq fell FIVE and a HALF percent.
[energetic explainer, leaning in] So why? [pause] Reason ONE: [short pause] AI lives in giant computer warehouses, [short pause] called DATA centers.
[explaining, building momentum] Investors fear the election could SLOW building them. [short pause] FEWER data centers, [short pause] fewer CHIPS sold.
[lighter, warm, almost smiling] Like a BRICK maker, hearing the town might stop new HOUSES.
[energetic, turning the page] Reason TWO: [short pause] big tech is spending HUGE sums on AI, and profits look slower.
[lighter, warm, playful] Like a LEMONADE stand that's worth LESS once sales slow down.
[energetic, turning the page] Reason THREE: [short pause] worry about higher INTEREST rates. [short pause] SAFE savings pay more, so some money leaves RISKY stocks.
[playful, smiling] Like kids leaving the CANDY line when the ice-cream TRUCK shows up!
[slow, dramatic, genuinely curious] So... [short pause] did the ELECTION cause it?
[confident verdict, clear P] Partly. [short pause] It was Thursday's SPARK. [short pause] But the slide started BEFORE anyone voted.
[warm, wrapping up] Connected? [short pause] Yes. [short pause] But not the WHOLE story.
